title: userqueryvisualization
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser, webresourceid.

charttype.description: Indicates the library used to render the visualization.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

datadescription.description: Shows the fields that are used to display data in a chart, stored in XML format.

description.description: Type additional information to describe the chart, such as the filter criteria or intended audience.

enablecrosspartition.description: Tells whether the chart can retrieve data from all cluster partitions.

isdefault.description: Select whether the chart is the default chart for the view that it is associated with.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

name.description: Type a descriptive name for the chart.

presentationdescription.description: Contains the chart's formatting details and presentation properties, stored in XML format.

primaryentitytypecode.description: Type of entity which the user chart is attached.

userqueryvisualizationid.description: Unique identifier of the user chart.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the user chart.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user or team who is assigned to manage the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Shows the business unit that the record owner belongs to.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the user chart.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the user chart.

_webresourceid_value.description: Shows the web resource that will be displayed in the chart to the user.
